evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We construct a co-simulation benchmark pairing five candidate surrogates with detector-agnostic ground-truth perception labels at every decision window, identifying the multi-view coverage metric J_mv as the most reliable predictor.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Since ground truth is unavailable at decision time, the framework centers on surrogate metrics computed solely from a probabilistic occupancy grid of historical observations, which predicts the next-window perception performance of candidate poses.
